name: imessage-bridge-dapr
description: Dapr pubsub variant of imessage-bridge — runs over any of Dapr's 15+ pluggable pubsub backends. Default: local Redis container.

scripts.dapr:run: dapr run --app-id imsg-bridge --app-port 3000 --dapr-http-port 3500 --dapr-grpc-port 50001 --resources-path ./components -- node src/cli.mjs agent
